title: Institutional social profile
slide_intent: Keep the institution identifiable within a third-party interface because audiences encounter brands beyond owned websites.
strategic_value: A recognizable avatar can carry lab recognition into a platform’s fixed layout.
demonstration: A Facebook-style page combines a building cover photograph, lab monogram avatar and platform feed columns.
practical_value: Evaluate the distinct jobs of avatar and cover image.
